purpose: Replace same-entry-bar Bollinger diagnostics with a causal prior-completed-M5 state for any promotion-eligible performance interpretation.

engine_semantics.breakout: signal is detected on the close of bar i and entry occurs at the open of bar i+1
engine_semantics.retest: retest confirmation is detected on the close of retest bar j and entry occurs at the open of bar j+1
engine_semantics.consequence: Bollinger state on the entry bar itself is not fully known at entry and must not be used for strategy performance conclusions.

bollinger_definition.state_rule: latest completed M5 bar strictly before entry_time

research_candidate_recheck.definition: long + causal position >= 0.75 + causal bandwidth > causal median

interpretation.same_entry_bar_evidence: diagnostic only; superseded for strategy conclusions because it contains future information relative to entry
interpretation.causal_result: the earlier very strong BB effect weakens materially after removing look-ahead, but the retest branch remains positive in all three broad eras and is still hypothesis-worthy
interpretation.next: exact engine cost stress and prospective/fixed-threshold validation only; do not optimize thresholds on these OOS results
